top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
top_sast_rules.description: Extracting files from a malicious ZIP file, or similar type of archive, without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can allow an attacker to unexpectedly gain access to resources.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement path validation using canonical paths. Reject paths containing '../' or similar traversal sequences.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command ('Argument Injection')
top_sast_rules.description: Forwarding command-line arguments to a child process executed within a shell may indirectly introduce command-line injection vulnerabilities.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
top_sast_rules.description: Memory operations access outside the intended buffer boundary.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-119 memory-buffer bounds pointer overflow underflow memcpy strcpy allocation index length out-of-bounds read write
top_sast_rules.remediation: Validate buffer sizes, offsets, indexes, and memory-copy lengths.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
top_sast_rules.description: Externally influenced data changes the syntax or meaning of a command sent to a downstream command interpreter.
